name: WSDL Endpoint
description: Schema describing an endpoint element within a WSDL 2.0 service. An endpoint associates a network address with a specific binding, defining where and how a web service can be accessed.

name.description: The local name of the endpoint, unique within its parent service.

binding.description: A qualified name referencing the binding used by this endpoint.

address.description: The network address (URI) where this endpoint can be reached.
